text:
Marta L.: Heads-up: SI ran into an install failure for Marketplace on customer EKS. Installer can't pull our images because cluster egress is locked down to a corporate proxy with no static external IP.
Devin K.: Can you paste the exact error?
Marta L.: From the SI engineer: 
```
time="2026-03-18T09:12:03Z" level=error msg="failed to pull image" err="Get \"https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/\": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 10.11.0.12:3128: connect: network is unreachable"
```
Samuel R.: OK, two paths: 1) have customer's netops open egress to our registry IPs for the install window, 2) use our offline bundle + local mirror, 3) prefetch images via privileged DaemonSet from a node that has working egress.
Priya S.: customer is a security shop; netops won't open long-lived rules. They asked if we can provide a one-time signed bundle that their infra team can import into a locked registry mirror.
Devin K.: we have signed bundles. Link?
Marta L.: I shared this earlier but reposting: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/offline-bundles/k8s-1.26/v1.3.0-signed.tar.gz 
Priya S.: perfect. They prefer the mirror flow. They also asked for a minimal checklist so their infra can import and verify signatures.
Samuel R.: I'll draft a two-step checklist: 
- checksum + GPG verify the tarball
- load images into local registry with `ctr` or `podman`
- update Helm values: `image.repository` -> `local.registry:5000/redwood` and set `imagePullSecrets`
Marta L.: also include a short fallback for urgent installs: privileged DaemonSet prefetch. Many SI teams can run that transiently if they accept the security caveats.
Devin K.: here's a small prefetch DaemonSet we use in POCs: 
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: redwood-prefetch
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: redwood-prefetch
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: redwood-prefetch
    spec:
      hostNetwork: true
      tolerations:
      - operator: Exists
      containers:
      - name: puller
        image: registry.redwood.ai/tools/puller:stable
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
        env:
        - name: IMAGES
          value: "registry.redwood.ai/edge-agent:1.3.0,registry.redwood.ai/optimizer:1.2.4"
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","/usr/local/bin/pull-images $IMAGES"]
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
```
Priya S.: SI asked if the puller image can run without privileged permissions. Answer: not reliably for all runtimes; it depends on the node runtime and whether `ctr`/`crictl` are available. We'll mark it as an advanced fallback only.
deploy-bot: marketplace-install job failed for customer-x (job id 6789) -- see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/marketplace/6789/logs
Marta L.: Next steps agreed with SI: they will try the signed bundle + mirror. If they can't complete in 3 hours, they will request approval for a transient privileged DaemonSet and provide the SOC checklist.
Samuel R.: I'll produce the mirror import checklist and a short SOC approval template.
Devin K.: I'll prepare a non-privileged variant that tries to use `podman` if present; will post it in PR.
Priya S.: thanks all. Adding a permanent note in the partner-runbook: "marketplace installs behind strict egress proxies -> prefer signed bundle + local mirror; privileged prefetch only if approved."
Marta L.: closing loop with SI now. Will update when they confirm. :thumbsup:
